# IT System Optimization and Security Review

This document details key initiatives for maintaining and enhancing the bank's IT infrastructure.

## Firewall Management

*   Optimize firewall settings based on standard updates.
*   Optimize firewall settings based on audit recommendations.
*   Investigate firewall settings based on audit findings.

## API Performance

*   Urgently investigate API latency issues.

## Encryption Standards

*   Quarterly investigation and review of encryption standards.
